charge:
EEOC FORM 5 (11/09)
CHARGE OF DISCRIMINATION
Charge No. 410-2026-10003
EEOC Office: Phoenix District Office
Charging Party: Avery Goldsmith
City/State: Denver, CO
Respondent: Summit Consulting Corp.
DISCRIMINATION BASED ON: Religion
DATE(S) DISCRIMINATION TOOK PLACE: Earliest 06/12/2025 Latest 10/08/2025
THE PARTICULARS ARE:
1. I was employed by Summit Consulting Corp beginning before June 12, 2025. The conduct
described below began on or about June 12, 2025 and continued through October 08, 2025.
2. I requested a reasonable accommodation and my request was denied without discussion.
3. I believe I have been discriminated against because of my religion, in violation of
applicable federal law.
notice:
U.S. EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY COMMISSION
Phoenix District Office
NOTICE OF CHARGE OF DISCRIMINATION
Date of Notice: 12/18/2025
To: Summit Consulting Corp.
Re: Charge No. 410-2026-10003
This is notice that a charge of employment discrimination has been filed against your
organization. No action is required on your part at this time. A position statement may be
requested.
